channels.field_matching: Executes detector-derived constraints that are registered to a technique -> Track A only; disabled in Track B (no constraints are loaded).
channels.tfidf_bm25: Text only. Leaks exactly what the query contains; Track B query = filtered event fields only.
channels.hierarchy: Operates on KB records (tactic/parent) -> no query information; no leakage.
channels.query_construction: FINDING: eval.alert_query renders Falco 'raw' text from the rule's own output template, looked up by rule title; 'title_raw' prepends the detector title; 'rewrite' uses hand-written scenario rules keyed on title/rule. All three carry detector-authored wording.
channels.knowledge_generation: FINDING: generated knowledge is attached to the technique the operator registered for each detector (registry from ground_truth.json) -> Track A only; Track B KB is the unmodified ATT&CK corpus (assert_kb_clean).
channels.metadata_lookup: Registry lookup uses scenario id -> diagnostic upper bound, never a Track B method.

residual_key_name_fingerprint.interpretation: Accuracy far above the majority rate means field-name schema alone identifies the detector; Track B cannot remove this.
